   • User hasn't given consent yet, but tracking already started

   • OneTrust allows scripts to load before user interaction
   • Companies tracking without consent: 6sense, Quantcast, Google, Facebook/Meta, LinkedIn

   • Reconfigure OneTrust to block ALL tracking until after user consent
   • Move all tracking scripts to load only AFTER consent is given
   • Test: User visits site → 0 tracking scripts should load until consent

   WHY THIS MATTERS:
   • Systematic GDPR violation - tracking users without any legal basis

   HOW TO FIX:

   • Priority: CRITICAL
   • Timeline: 1-2 weeks

🔴 [EU-C-011] Consent Bypass Violation 🔸 SECONDARY VIOLATION

   OBSERVED BEHAVIOR:
   • User clicked "Reject All" button on https://dell.com
   • Expected: All tracking should stop, existing tracking should remain unchanged
   • Reality: 11 additional tracking scripts loaded
   • Additional: 2 more tracking cookies set
   • Additional: 2 more tracking localStorage items
   • Scripts that ignored user rejection:
     - LinkedIn continues tracking (2 scripts)
     - Microsoft continues tracking (2 scripts)
     - Google continues tracking (2 scripts)
     - 6sense continues tracking (2 scripts)

   TECHNICAL ROOT CAUSE:
   • OneTrust is misconfigured - treats tracking scripts as "necessary"
   • Microsoft Bing tracking runs regardless of user preference
   • Facebook tracking continues despite user rejection

   WHY THIS MATTERS:
   • Systematic GDPR violations - users can file complaints because their "No" is being ignored
   • This violates the core GDPR principle that "No means No"
   • Creates legal liability because consent mechanism is fundamentally broken

   HOW TO FIX:
   • Immediately reconfigure consent management system to respect user rejection
   • Reconfigure OneTrust: Move tracking scripts from "Strictly Necessary" to appropriate categories
   • Test fix: Click "Reject All" → verify 0 tracking scripts load
   • Priority: CRITICAL
   • Timeline: 1-2 weeks
